findings.summary: Raw/internal source provenance and private research were recursively publishable while the checker passed.
Docker build contexts included local secrets and operator/private state.
At least three daemon loops concurrently rewrite rankings/provider state and make metadata stale.
A migration manufactured validated/today/freshness states from citation counts; 112 records labeled validated, 60 internal-only, 90 without checklist.
Legacy rankings lack eligibility, coverage denominator, scale normalization, and kill/candidate exclusion.
Documented and runtime idea schemas disagreed.
Weak checks accepted stale revisions and timestamp churn.
Parallel provider path bypasses eligibility/capability/cost/key gates and races shared state; health modules are not authoritative runtime gates.
Terraform/API/IAM/secret/image/service topology does not prove a deployable authenticated control plane.
Realtime claims described browser-local storage and URL state did not synchronize.
Undefined citation variable blanked idea detail pages.
External automation moved HEAD and origin three times and committed mixed user/OMEGA work during the run.
